description: This file defines 'LauncherActivity', the main activity class for an Android multi-display launcher application. It manages UI components such as display selection, app grid, pinned apps, and app drawer, and handles launching apps on specific displays, including animations and configurations.

classes.name: LauncherActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for a multi-display Android launcher, handling app launching, display selection, app pinning, and UI animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, adapters, view models, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: onMenuItemClick
methods.description: Handles popup menu item selections for adding app shortcuts and setting wallpaper.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes such as orientation change, hides app drawer.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides back button to hide app drawer if shown.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, hides keyboard and app drawer.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an app intent, optionally on a specific display, with animation and error handling.

methods.name: refreshDisplayPicker
methods.description: Refreshes the list of available displays.

methods.name: showAppDrawer
methods.description: Animates showing or hiding the app drawer panel.

methods.name: revealAnimator
methods.description: Creates a circular reveal or hide animation for UI elements.
